title: Reinstatement Review Case Files and the Start of TRICARE Prime Catch-Up Billing
content:
**Desk guidance - TRICARE Prime catch-up installments on reinstated enrollments.**

Where a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment was brought back by an Enrollment Reinstatement Review (a case of Appeals and Grievances whose subject is that enrollment), the documents in the review's case file decide the month with which the catch-up installment starts.

## Clause

1. Where the review's case file holds **proof of payment**, the catch-up starts with the month after the month the review was decided - the region bearing the gap its own billing error caused.
2. Where it holds **medical records and no proof of payment**, the catch-up starts with the month after the old paid-through date - the beneficiary owing every restored month.
3. **Otherwise** it starts with the month the review was filed - the region bearing the months before the beneficiary came forward.

## Records read

From the Enrollment Reinstatement Review under Appeals and Grievances for this enrollment: the kinds of document in its case file, the date it was decided, the date it was filed and the old paid-through date recorded on the review.

## Combinations

| Proof of payment in the case file | Medical records in the case file | Catch-up starts with |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the month after the decision month |
| yes | no | the month after the decision month |
| no | yes | the month after the old paid-through month |
| no | no | the filing month |

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

Old paid-through date 28 February; review filed 14 April and decided 20 May.

- Proof of payment on file: the catch-up starts with June.
- Medical records only: it starts with March.
- Neither: it starts with April.
